manifest.name: Engineering goal manifest
manifest.authority: NONE — DERIVED TRUTH. This manifest legislates no goal, admits no capability, mints no identifier and grants no authorization. It RECORDS engineering goals as constitutional metadata so that the located engineering plane can be traversed for each of them. Every goal names a subject the repository already owns; a goal that named an unlocated subject would be a request to CREATE, and Repository Truth decides that, not this manifest.
manifest.admission: Append a node record to `nodes`, or add another manifest matching the located manifest pattern. No engine change, no declaration change, no architectural redesign. The engine never reads this file by name: it is discovered by the declared root and suffix, so a second manifest is admitted by dropping it in.
manifest.$ordinal_comment: Ordinals advance in steps so a goal recorded between two others takes an ordinal in the gap and no existing ordinal moves. An ordinal orders the traversal of goals; it confers no priority and no authority.
manifest.$subject_comment: `subject` names the located artifact the goal is about. It is what makes autonomous disposition determination possible: the engine measures the subject against Repository Truth and derives REUSE, EXTEND, CORRECT or CREATE from what it finds, rather than being told.
manifest.$class_comment: `class` names a located construct class. It is resolved against the discovered class plane, never interpreted here.
manifest.$reentry_comment: `reenters` records that engineering does not terminate: a goal re-enters the lifecycle rather than ending it (CR-INF-001). It is a relation, not a dependency edge, so the graph stays orderable and the lifecycle stays non-terminal.

nodes.goal: Bind an engineering goal to the located constitutional lifecycle and prove the binding is total
nodes.intent: The self-referential goal. Its subject is this engine, so this programme is engineered through the same constitutional lifecycle as every other subject: measured by the same obligations, disposed by the same rules, planned over the same consumed stage graph. Nothing distinguishes it, which is what makes the absence of a privileged engineering path mechanical rather than documentary. Recording it is also the honest test of the disposition rules — if they were written to flatter this programme, this is the goal that would expose it.
